title: 5.3.3. Anāgatavāra
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Yo dukkhasaccaṁ parijānissati so samudayasaccaṁ pajahissatīti? Āmantā.
Yo dukkhasaccaṁ na parijānissati so samudayasaccaṁ nappajahissatīti? Āmantā.
